claims: Monitor hemoglobin and hematocrit for anemia (Hgb 9.6-10.2 g/dL, Hct 27.6-28.5%).
Monitor blood pressure closely given hypertensive readings (e.g., 145/126 mmHg) and alarm limits.
Monitor heart rate given tachycardia alarm threshold of 120 bpm and prior elevated readings.
Monitor oxygen saturation given desaturation limit of 88% and pulse oximetry alarms.
Assess and manage pain given current pain score of 0 and Braden nutrition score indicating probable inadequate nutrition.
Monitor renal function with creatinine 1.1 mg/dL and BUN 21 mg/dL.
Monitor electrolytes including sodium 140, potassium 3.9, chloride 109, bicarbonate 23, magnesium 2.0, phosphate 3.6.
Monitor liver function tests (ALT 8, AST 12, alkaline phosphatase 46, total bilirubin 0.3, albumin 3.1).
Monitor coagulation status (PT 13.1 sec, PTT 33 sec, INR 1.2).
Maintain fall precautions given bed rest and weak gait/transferring status.
